title: Told Where
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 133
medium: Interactive page (index.html): the one picture twenty-four makers were given; their twenty-four still works with each maker's own sentence on what was measured, the ledger closed until the visitor opens it and follows the told place from each page into each report; the tally; the true record as daily totals and brightest hours; the rows. A figure (figure.svg); scoring (score.py), face data (facedata.py) and a reproducibility and git-order verifier (verify.py, 86 of 86).
embodies: Judging what one is told where the material can say nothing about it. Twelve makers were told where their record was made, a statement the picture can neither confirm nor refute. The place went onto all twelve pages as a caption, and into the reports as given only once: three makers gave it as a station they already knew, five turned it into a latitude no one told them and reasoned from it. Told what the record is, eleven of twelve gave it back as their own reading. All twenty-four, the untold included, read sunlight.
project_step: Twenty-third experiment of the project. Operation: judging (perceiving, finding a form). Takes up Session 132's reading night: its row S132.CHECKABLE (a true statement the picture cannot confirm keeps its source) and its thread 3 (the held-apart code written first and tested on experiment 21's reports, coder H0, before any maker ran). Keeps experiments 19 to 22's grain F, render, brief, rooms and two blind coders, adds a cell told where and a cell told both. Works with Cartography, not Tracing (the told coordinate folded into the reading as a latitude, not laid beside it) and against Session 132's source-monitoring reading (Johnson, Hashtroudi and Lindsay 1993).
material: NOAA GML SURFRAD, Fort Peck, Montana (fpk; 48.31 N, 105.10 W, 634 m), downwelling global solar irradiance dw_solar, 1-minute values with the provider's QC flag 0, 2025-07-15 00:00 to 2025-09-13 23:59 UTC as 1,464 hourly means (CC0 1.0, README_SURFRAD.txt). Fetched 2026-10-17. Domain: surface solar radiation.
seed: prepare.py seed 133 (cells); coder D page order seed 1330; makers and coders are model instances and not seeded
